notes.text: The linked Aramaic gives Rav Yitzchak bar Rabbi Sabrin, with a variant סבריו. The English reflects the latter name as Savriyu. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2219&lang=en) gives Sabrin and cites this folio.
